definition: a vote to choose a winner for a position
description: Inside a polling station. An older woman with red glasses and a flowered scarf stands in a cardboard voting booth with a yellow pencil in her hand and a long printed sheet of empty boxes on the shelf in front of her. She frowns down the sheet, taps the pencil against her lips and looks up while she thinks, then bends over the paper and puts a firm tick in one of the boxes. She straightens up out of the booth with the paper and the pencil and smiles. A queue of other voters waits behind her in the hall.

en.question: What is the older woman doing?

de.answer: Sie kreuzt ein Kästchen auf ihrem Stimmzettel an.

es.answer: Está marcando una casilla en su papeleta.
phrases: salir de la cabina de votación
